title: Add Assignee-Aware Filtering to Tasks Board
description:
The /tasks board supports label filters and status columns but lacks an assignee filter. With 266+ tasks in the backlog, a contributor or agent needs to quickly narrow to 'show only tasks assigned to me' or 'show only Copilot-assigned tasks'. This is the 'Assignee-aware filtering' gap identified in the June 2026 LLMWikiServer parity review.

### Motivation
The LLMWikiServer team specifically called this out as a triage efficiency gap when working with MemorySmith's task structure. On boards with hundreds of tasks, unfiltered views have O(n) scan cost.

### Acceptance Criteria
- An Assignee filter dropdown appears in the /tasks filter bar, alongside the existing label and status filters
- Filter options include 'Unassigned', 'Me' (requires authenticated user), all Directory mode users, all Custom text values present in the current task set
- The selected filter is preserved in the URL query string for shareability
- The filter is combined (AND) with existing label and status filters
- The filter applies to both the board (kanban) view and the list view

### Extensions to Consider
- Add assignee as a sortable column in the list view
- Support multi-select assignee filter ('show tasks assigned to A or B')
- Add 'Assigned to me' as a quick-access chip in the filter bar
- Expose via API GET /api/tasks?assignee=... filter parameter

### Implementation Notes
- Tasks use two assignee modes: AssigneeMode='Directory' (resolves via directory ID) and AssigneeMode='Custom' (free text). The filter needs to handle both display paths.
- The existing hybrid lexical+semantic search (MemorySmith:TaskSearch:HybridSemanticEnabled) does not natively filter by structured fields; this filter should operate at the service layer before search ranking.

### Source
Originated from external parity review (LLMWikiServer, June 2026). Memory: external-parity-observations-20260601.

comments.Body: UX gap identified in June 2026 external parity review (LLMWikiServer). Low priority relative to TSK-0267 and TSK-0268 but quick to implement given the existing filter bar infrastructure. With 266+ tasks in the repo and growing, this becomes increasingly painful without it.
